summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring FLUME VAE encoding, EVO lifecycle tracking, SurrealDB journey persistence, Mycelium skill synthesis, and Ouroboros anomaly detection into a continuously self-improving autoresearch loop.
summary.outcome: Delivered E1-E6 (core EVO capture pipeline), discovered and fixed the E57 architectural bug in apply_mycelium_feedback (SET→additive accumulation), validated the convergence formula consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125×(1−lr/2)^n, confirmed the full E3/E6 production pipeline (E62), committed 11 regression tests, added retirement criterion and E63/E64 to the overnight loop, and logged 29,000+ autoresearch runs.

repo: run_llm_deliberation() in overnight_evo_loop.py unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments on every call — Mycelium feedback must target _mycelium_calibration instead, which survives the call
SurrealDBClient.connect() was entirely simulated (set self.connected=True with no HTTP call); required full rewrite to httpx with RETURN true; probe

SurrealDB requires RETURN true; (not SELECT 1;) as health probe, time::now() for datetime fields, and SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields — EVO biographies must go in option<string> result field
TelemetryBus.start() and JourneyWorker.start() both require explicit calls; bus events queue silently with no consumer and are lost on process exit
SCHEDULE labels in overnight_evo_loop.py must exactly match the experiment= string passed to log_result() for the retirement criterion to fire correctly

ManifoldEnv: 19D obs (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space; verifiable reward = 0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge; r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position) peaks at 1.0 when all dims=0.5

SwarmEnv 4-agent gauge coupling (strength=0.15): all-optimal can score LESS than all-naive due to field interference from large simultaneous actions; mixed teams sometimes outperform both homogeneous conditions

JEPA learning is bounded by input distribution diversity — heuristic mode produces a single-attractor distribution; replay buffers don't help; genuine JEPA learning requires LLM mode with real score variance
E51 ran 4,786 times because no retirement criterion existed; CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps is the correct self-prune rule
E47 voice profile experiments must modify _mycelium_calibration (stable cross-cycle), not _score_adjustments (overwritten per deliberation by run_llm_deliberation)
ExperienceEncoder.encode() produces 256D: [0:12]=12D trajectory, [12:24]=12 scalars, [29:256]=SHA-256 semantic fingerprint; first 12 dims ARE the state_12d
asyncio.wait_for with a negative timeout raises TimeoutError immediately with no sleep — creates spin-loop when remaining session time < 10s; must guard with max(30.0, remaining_s - 10)

code.finding: E57 fix: _mycelium_calibration must be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0); apply_mycelium_feedback must use += into _mycelium_calibration then copy to _score_adjustments, not SET _score_adjustments directly — SET causes cycle-2 decay, additive produces monotonic compounding

_evaluate_resource extended with description keyword check: any(['cost','budget','efficient','resource','reduce'] in desc_lower) gives +0.10 bonus, making resource voice text-sensitive like the other three voices

Full rewrite from simulation to real HTTP: headers need Authorization: Basic root:root, surreal-ns: cohezion, surreal-db: main, Accept: application/json; CREATE journey_point must use timestamp=time::now() not string literals; EVO biographies must go in result (option<string>) field not metadata

Updated to call insert_flume_journey_event(event) preferentially over insert_trajectory_node path; but overnight loop manually pulling events from bus queue via get_nowait() bypasses this worker entirely

Two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration holds stable cross-cycle gains, per-deliberation LLM mode SETs _score_adjustments as (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib; accumulating _mycelium_calibration without this separation causes score inflation capping all voices at 1.0

Synthesized skill content format for apply_mycelium_feedback parsing must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' pattern (output of _synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill), not 'voice_scores=[...]' format (input to ingest_evo_journeys)
Deadline guard: asyncio.wait_for timeout must be max(30.0, remaining_s - 10); break outer loop when remaining < 30s; without this the script enters a tight spin-loop at end of session

hiho_time_ratio (fraction of episode spent in HIHO band) is the correct quality metric for comparing proposal conditions — not mean_final_dev (both conditions converge near-equally at 300 steps) nor total_reward (penalized by energy costs from larger actions)

workflow: Pre-specify hypothesis, null hypothesis, falsification criterion, and achievability check before writing experiment code — 3 of 10 experiments needed redesign mid-stream because the keep criterion was never achievable
timeit.default_timer() is the correct wall-clock instrument: monotonic, sub-microsecond, unaffected by NTP corrections
ruff format --check pre-commit hook requires manual ruff format before staging; ruff also reformats files after edits, requiring re-stage
Gemini worktrees are ephemeral and get silently cleaned up — commit everything to the main working tree immediately, never keep substantive work only in a worktree

CV (coefficient of variation) of last 10 keep metrics < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 is a reliable retirement signal for converged autoresearch experiments; 0% keep with n_runs >= 20 retires confirmed-noise experiments
For closed-loop experiments, call nexus.deliberate() directly instead of run_llm_deliberation() when testing Mycelium feedback — the LLM path resets _score_adjustments and masks the effect
IEEE 754: sum([0.85]*n)/n is not >= 0.85 in floating point — use result.approved (direct comparison against the class constant) as authoritative threshold-crossing check
Running autorun/autoresearch background processes benefit from strict per-slot timeout guards, a SIGTERM handler, and a keep-metric-per-label stats accumulator to surface signal vs noise quickly
